proof_body:
by
  intro 𝕜 _ H _ _ x a hw hn
  rw [tendsto_iff_norm_sub_tendsto_zero]
  have h1 : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ‖x n - a‖ ^ 2) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
    have heq : ∀ n, ‖x n - a‖ ^ 2 = ‖x n‖ ^ 2 - 2 * RCLike.re (inner 𝕜 a (x n)) + ‖a‖ ^ 2 := by
      intro n
      rw [@norm_sub_sq 𝕜, inner_re_symm]
    simp_rw [heq]
    have h2 := ((RCLike.continuous_re.tendsto _).comp (hw a))
    have h3 := ((hn.pow 2).sub (h2.const_mul 2)).add_const (‖a‖ ^ 2)
    have h4 : ‖a‖ ^ 2 - 2 * RCLike.re (inner 𝕜 a a) + ‖a‖ ^ 2 = 0 := by
      rw [inner_self_eq_norm_sq (𝕜 := 𝕜)]; ring
    rw [h4] at h3
    exact h3
  have h5 := h1.sqrt
  simpa [Real.sqrt_sq (norm_nonneg _)] using h5
target_source: ∀ (𝕜 : Type*) [RCLike 𝕜] (H : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace 𝕜 H] (x : ℕ → H) (a : H), (∀ y, Filter.Tendsto (fun n => inner 𝕜 y (x n)) Filter.atTop (nhds (inner 𝕜 y a))) → Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ‖x n‖) Filter.atTop (nhds ‖a‖) → Filter.Tendsto x Filter.atTop (nhds a)
